description: Circular torus, toroidal winding. R=0.15m, r=0.02m, N=100, I=1A. Each turn is a large horizontal loop around the torus axis. Turns distributed evenly around the tube cross-section by poloidal angle.

geometry_interpretation.centreline: circle of radius majorRadius=0.15m in XY plane, axis=Z
geometry_interpretation.turn_k_loop_normal: (0, 0, 1) for all turns — each turn is an azimuthal loop whose normal is the torus axis Z

winding_mode_interpretation.description: Each turn k is a closed horizontal loop of circumference 2*pi*rho_k wound around the torus axis. The N turns are distributed evenly around the tube cross-section by poloidal angle psi_k = 2*pi*k/N.
winding_mode_interpretation.per_turn_wire_length_avg: 2 * pi * R = 2 * pi * 0.15 = 0.9425 m  (average over N turns, since mean of cos(psi_k) = 0)

discretisation_interpretation.path_k_description: Horizontal circle at height z_k = r*sin(psi_k), effective radius rho_k = R + r*cos(psi_k). All paths have normal (0,0,1).
discretisation_interpretation.path_k_parametric: p_k(phi) = (R + r cos psi_k)(cos phi, sin phi, 0) + (0, 0, r sin psi_k),  phi in [0, 2pi)

checks.note: N * 2*pi*R = 100 * 2*pi*0.15 = 94.248 m. First-order approx; exact = sum_k 2*pi*rho_k = 2*pi*(N*R + r*sum(cos psi_k)) = 2*pi*N*R since sum(cos(2*pi*k/N)) = 0 for k=0..N-1.
psi_0=0: rho_0=R+r=0.17m, z_0=0. Outermost horizontal circle in the z=0 plane.
All toroidal turns are azimuthal loops with normal = Z-axis
Outside torus (r > R+r_tube): B must be near zero by Ampere's law.
